name: @entelekheia/governance-style
description: The default style layer: how a generated document is written — phrasing, budget, tables, diagrams — plus one fragment per artefact it documents a delta for
_comment_files: style/ carries general.md and the target fragments, read directly from that directory by composeStylePolicy (@entelekheia/governance-base) — never through defineGovernance's facets indirection, which type.json's own facets.policy entry only documents for a plain single-facet read. The directory is what lets this package hold a README.md of its own: at the root, readme.md occupied that name on any case-insensitive filesystem (issue #31).
